name: Ward 1
boundary_summary: Ambala Road municipal limit, Bilaspur Road, Rakshak Vihar, military ground, BDPO office, Sector 18 road, Town Park, Ratouli and Kansapur Road form principal boundary references. Sector 18 road is a boundary reference, not an assignment of the whole sector.

name: Ward 2
boundary_summary: Rakshak Vihar on Bilaspur Road, Hanuman Gate Chowk, government school and Ambala Road define the main boundary circuit in Jagadhri. The municipal locality index also lists old-city markets including Khera Bazar and Pansari Bazar.

name: Ward 3
boundary_summary: Old Bilaspur Road runs north to the municipal limit, then along the limit to Kharwan Road, Chhachhrauli Road, Chaneti Chowk, Hanuman Gate and Gugga Madi before returning through Old Chhachhrauli Road.

name: Ward 4
boundary_summary: Buria Chowk, Vishwakarma Dharamshala, Chaneti Chowk, Kharwan Chowk, the eastern municipal limit, Amadalpur Road, Bhagwangarh and Buria Road form the boundary circuit.

name: Ward 5
boundary_summary: Ambala Road near Jagadhri bus stand, Hanuman Gate, Vishwakarma Dharamshala, Buria Chowk, Bhagwangarh, the eastern municipal limit and Saharanpur Road bound this Jagadhri ward.

name: Ward 6
boundary_summary: Jagadhri bus stand, Saharanpur Road-side points, Tejli Road, Jagadhri Road and Sector 17 including its gurudwara are the main boundary references. Sector 17 is shared with Ward 7.

name: Ward 7
boundary_summary: Military ground on Ambala Road, Jagadhri bus stand, Sector 17 gurudwara, Gobindpura, Spring Field Public School and the road toward Sector 18 form the main circuit. Sector 17 is shared with Ward 6; Sector 18 entries are shared with Ward 22.

name: Ward 8
boundary_summary: Kanhaiya Sahib Chowk, Gobindpuri-side streets, Sector 17 Road, Honda agency, Railway Road, Bhagat Singh Chowk and Maharana Pratap Chowk define the boundary circuit. Some Professor Colony and Sarojni Colony entries are shared with other wards.

name: Ward 9
boundary_summary: Bhagat Singh Chowk, Jagadhri Road, ESI Hospital, Tejli Road and Guru Nanak Khalsa College are the principal boundary references. Model Colony is distinct from Model Town in Ward 8.

name: Ward 10
boundary_summary: Guru Nanak Khalsa College, Chitta Mandir Road, Yamuna canal bank, railway line, Railway Station Road and City Centre Road form the main circuit. Dasmesh Colony and Yamuna Gali entries include shared ward assignments.

name: Ward 11
boundary_summary: Yamuna canal, Chitta Mandir Road, Azad Nagar Chowk, Lal Dwara Road, Tejli Road, Saharanpur Road and the eastern municipal limit define the principal boundary circuit. The municipal locality index places Sector 15 Phase I and II in this ward.

name: Ward 12
boundary_summary: Starts at the railway line beside the Yamuna, follows the watercourse toward the municipal limit, continues along the municipal limit through Daulatpur and returns along the Yamuna to the railway. Several villages and colonies have split assignments in the municipal index.

name: Ward 13
boundary_summary: Radaur Road, Garhi Road, the Yamuna bank and Mumidi village define the principal circuit with street-level turns north of Radaur Road. The Radaur Road industrial area is indexed across Wards 13 and 18.

name: Ward 14
boundary_summary: Saharanpur Road, Saraswati Sugar Mill Colony boundary, railway line, Yamuna bank and Garhi Road enclose the principal circuit. Sugar Mill Colony and Hamida Colony have entries assigned to more than one ward.

name: Ward 15
boundary_summary: Maharana Pratap Chowk, Khalsa College, Satya Narayan Dharamshala, Railway Road, railway station, railway line and bypass bridge form the circuit. The municipal index places the old Radaur Road bazaar and Workshop Road municipal shops in this ward.

name: Ward 16
boundary_summary: Maharana Pratap Chowk south to the bypass bridge, west along the railway line, north to Workshop Road at Guru Teg Bahadur Chowk and east along Workshop Road back to the start.

name: Ward 17
boundary_summary: Radaur Road north through intermediate points to the railway line, east along the railway, south along Saraswati Sugar Mill Colony boundary to Saharanpur Road and west back to Radaur Road.

name: Ward 18
boundary_summary: Railway line near Prithvi Nagar, Radaur Road, Mumidi village, Yamuna canal and the southwestern municipal limit form the principal circuit. The municipal index assigns Mandebar to Ward 18, although a separate outside-Lal-Dora Mandebar entry is labelled Ward 13.

name: Ward 19
boundary_summary: Guru Teg Bahadur Chowk, railway line, western municipal limit, Ratouli village phirni, Shivanand School, Sasauli Road, DAV School and Railway Workshop boundary define the principal circuit.

name: Ward 20
boundary_summary: Railway Workshop Road, Railway Colony boundary, DAV School, Sasauli Road, ITI Yamunanagar boundary, Arjun Park, Jagadhri Road and Maharana Pratap Chowk form the main circuit.

name: Ward 21
boundary_summary: Sharma Karyana Store in Sasauli, Ratouli Road, Rama Krishna School and ITI Yamunanagar boundary are principal references in a detailed street-level circuit. Several Bank Colony, Bhagwati Colony and Rajiv Garden entries are shared with neighbouring wards.

name: Ward 22
boundary_summary: Hanuman Mandir on Jagadhri Road, Arjun Park, New Rama Krishna School, Ratouli Road, Sector 18 road, Gobindpura phirni, Jagadhri Main Road, Gobindpuri Road and Kanhaiya Sahib Chowk form the main circuit. Sector 18 and Sector 18A are shared with Ward 7.
